title: Hobonichi Techo Weeks 2025 Planner
description_en: The cult-favorite Hobonichi Techo Weeks — a slim weekly planner printed on ultra-thin Tomoe River paper that resists bleed from fountain pens. A beloved ritual for planners worldwide.
description_ja: 熱狂的ファンを持つほぼ日手帳Weeks。トモエリバー紙で万年筆もにじまない、薄くて軽い週間手帳。世界中のプランナーに愛される一冊。
